entities.summary: King Suriyenthrathibodi or Luang Sorasak —was originally named Duea or Maduea, and King Chulalongkorn later issued a royal judgement identifying his regnal name as Sanphet VIII. He was the 29th monarch of the Ayutthaya Kingdom and the second king of the Ban Phlu Luang dynasty, the last dynasty of Ayutthaya.
